notes.title: Mammoth Update
notes.notes: New character added - Wooly the mammoth, he features the same abilities as Ele but is more fluffy

notes.title: Epic Leaderboard Update
notes.notes: Implemented a leaderboard system so players can now prove who is the best in the world! There is also now no score limit, enemies and humans continue to respawn in an endless cycle of doom!

notes.title: Update 5 (NEW ABILITY)
notes.notes: Added a water blast ability using the spacebar/left click or R1/R2 (RB/RT), this attack destroys the enemies who were previously invincible, ELE is back with a vengeance!! It's time to RAMPAGE.

notes.title: Update 4
notes.notes: Added graphics settings!! (better late than never right?) Windowed/Full screen options, Resolution, Texture Detail, Shadow Detail and Frame Rate settings (30fps - 120fps)

notes.title: Update 2
notes.notes:
Added 2 levels featuring a new area and new enemies 

Added controller support

Added pause function

notes.title: Update 1
notes.notes:
Added save and load functions, game will automatically save at the start of each level (except level 1)

Extended the hitbox for the player (hurtbox has not been changed)
